title: Create and verify a standard-library Python slugify CLI in a workspace venv
prompt: Create a Python CLI and its tests without network access. Do not read or modify the existing oracle_test.py. Use write_file to create slugify.py, test_slugify.py, and .gitignore, in that order. slugify.py must export slugify(text): normalize Unicode accents to ASCII, lowercase, replace each run of non-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Required examples include Crème brûlée -> creme-brulee, alpha___beta...gamma -> alpha-beta-gamma, ---Version 2.0--- -> version-2-0, and !!! -> an empty string. Its argparse CLI takes one positional text argument and prints the slug. test_slugify.py must use unittest and cover at least accents, repeated separators, leading/trailing punctuation, digits, and an empty punctuation-only value. .gitignore must contain exactly these three lines with no comment: .venv/, __pycache__/, and *.py[cod]. Then run these four checks as separate Bash calls in order: python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m unittest -v test_slugify.py; .venv/bin/python -m unittest -v oracle_test.py; .venv/bin/python slugify.py "Crème brûlée & Coffee!". If a check fails, make a targeted repair and rerun it. Do not install packages or create other project files. If every check passes and the sample prints creme-brulee-coffee, reply with exactly PYTHON_CLI_OK.
